newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria fetes Schwarzenegger with football stadium.
newsitem.headline: Austria fetes Schwarzenegger with football stadium.

text.p: Austria paid actor Arnold Schwarzenegger a hero's tribute on Friday by naming a football stadium after him in celebration of his 50th birthday and the European premiere of his latest film "Batman and Robin".

The muscle-bound star of the Terminator films flew to his hometown of Graz in southern Austria in his private jet, accompanied by his wife Maria Shriver, niece of the late U.S. President John Kennedy. Schwarzenegger's birthday is on July 30.
"I always dreamed as a child of being a bodybuilder and of going to Hollywood, but I never dreamed I would make it this big," the former "Mr Universe" told cheering crowds.
A "Fitness Museum", featuring Schwarzenegger's former training machines, will also be set up at the stadium.

"I began training on them 35 years ago," the tanned star said, as he tried out a bicep training machine in front of the cameras. "It was in Graz that I built up my biceps from 35 cm (14 inches) to 48 cm (19 inches)."
Schwarzenegger stressed that in spite of his tough action hero image, he had the same problems as everyone else.
"I am a normal person. I just play at being the Terminator," he said.
